scope: Adaptive repeated development on the same 4977 Okutama centers; an external scenario set is required for confirmation
research_question: Does supervision at the already cached physical actor frames teach a local evidence residual that improves the M4/A3 anchor across unseen scenarios?

arms.f1_fixed_geometric_m4_a3: fixed 0.10 per-seed log-space A3 residual; adaptive screen sentinel
arms.f2_center_only_supervision: anchored residual with auxiliary supervision only at the immutable center frame
arms.f3_all_cached_frame_supervision: same anchored residual with auxiliary supervision at all valid known cached frames
arms.f4_center_only_standalone: standalone local probabilities from the f2 checkpoint
arms.f5_all_cached_frame_standalone: standalone local probabilities from the f3 checkpoint

inputs.short_dino: 4977 x 16 x 768 frozen DINOv2-base frame CLS cache
inputs.long_dino: 4977 x 16 x 768 frozen DINOv2-base long-window frame CLS cache
inputs.anchor: selected inner OOF and three outer-refit seeds from new-source M4 and A3
inputs.annotation_source: the same 21 permitted provider-training recordings already used to derive memory supervision

frame_supervision.target: unique mapped base activity at each exact cached provider frame
frame_supervision.unknown_policy: missing, lost, unsupported or multi-base-action frames are masked
frame_supervision.crop_variant_policy: retain nonidentical cached crop variants but divide their total weight by the physical-frame multiplicity
frame_supervision.training_scenario_policy: all auxiliary observations must belong to a center row in the current outer-training scenarios; physical identities crossing the held scenario are forbidden
frame_supervision.control_source: short_dino center index only, repeated to match candidate optimizer steps

architecture.name: Frame-Supervised Anchored Residual (FSAR)
architecture.exact_fallback: f0 copies M4; a zero local residual copies f1 byte-for-byte

training.class_loss: class-balanced from the current outer-training population only; center and auxiliary weighted means both divide by the sum of effective selected class weights
training.optimizer_step_matching: both arms take the candidate all-frame number of steps; the center-only auxiliary stream cycles deterministically
training.selection: none; architecture and all optimization values fixed before fitting
training.outer_metric_embargo: individual fits save probabilities without held labels or metrics; scores release only after the exact30-fit inventory validates

statistics.intersection_union_success: Both predeclared primary contrasts must pass their exact one-sided scenario-swap alpha gates; no multiplicity adjustment is needed for this conjunction claim
statistics.calibration_safety: NLL and Brier noninferiority use the one-sided 95% upper scenario-bootstrap delta versus exact M4
statistics.interpretation: uncertainty remains exploratory under adaptive dataset reuse

stop_rules.candidate_not_better_than_center_control: additional cached labels, not the architecture, fail this trial
stop_rules.standalone_heads_weak_and_anchor_unchang: do not expand this CLS-only branch to dense per-frame patches
stop_rules.candidate_improves_anchor_safely: advance to actor-relative transported dense parts with this supervision shared by all controls
stop_rules.reporting: use screen_gate_passed, never promotion_passed; confirmation remains external
